title: Page 2
content_zh:
这可是为客的基本之道。
没一会儿，曲母从灶房端了碟小菜出来。
“这是我们如意亲手腌的酱瓜，很脆，您试试尝尝，开开胃。”
曲母才刚放下，一股咸而鲜的香气便朝段柯古涌来。他口中唾液一阵涌动，挟一块进嘴才知曲母为何敢如此夸口。这酱瓜果真脆咸清芬，入嘴便可尝到一股甘甜，教人一尝再尝，舍不得停筷。
一盘见底，段柯古总算甘愿抬头。他忍不住夸道：“瞧曲姑娘年纪尚轻，想不到就有这等手艺！”
就光这盘腌瓜，段柯古几乎要把曲如意跟“一条龙”掌杓龙焱相提并论了！
在长安，他曾向龙焱讨教过割烹技巧，知道手艺要精湛，努力与天分绝对少不了。依龙焱二十多岁能被称作“易牙再世”，已是百中选一，可现下，竟然还有名十七、八岁姑娘，就能做出此味醇甘美的酱菜！
曲母挺常听见女儿被夸，表情一派轻松。“别看我们如意年纪轻，她自会说话就开始在灶房里边打转。不过刚那盘酱瓜好吃，一半是靠先夫帮助，她爹留了一本菜谱，酱瓜要添什么、腌多久都写得……”
“娘！”如意突然跳出来打断。
段柯古吓了一跳，曲母也是。她聊得兴起，竟一下忘了她们有菜谱的事，可是不能提及的机密。
怎么了？脸色这么凝重？
段柯古正想问个清楚，可曲母却捂嘴噤口，一个劲儿地往内房退。
“我累了，我先进去休息——”
“大娘怎么了？”见如意端著炒饭靠近，段柯古忍不住问道。
如意不答，只是静静将陶盘一放，另只手搁下汤杓筷子。
“公子慢用。”
直到见著面前白黄杂色，粒粒分明的鸡子炒饭，段柯古一下忘了脑里的话。虽说同炒的配料是做肉饼余下，可咸鱼、肉末本就相当搭配鸡子与白饭，再撒上切细的青葱，更是活色生香。
舀一口进嘴，那米饭的弹、鸡子的软与咸鱼的香气沁入心脾。他这才知道自己方才的担心，多么可笑。
自开始吃饭，他再没空抬头说话过，只顾一口接一口，活似旁边有人想跟他抢似。
一盘吃罢，再啜一口仍温的茶——他舒心一吁，此时感觉，只能用通体舒畅四字形容。

难怪有诗赞：“江淮之间，广陵大镇，富甲天下。”扬州果真人杰地灵，就连路边一角的小店，也能做出此等美味！
再一想，他更是期待“小莲庄”厨子的手艺。
非要好好赞美她不可——只是人呢？段柯古吃得专心，竟连如意离去也没察觉。
他转身寻觅佳人身影。“如意姑娘？”
“我在里边。”
循声前往，正好看见她在灶房里边揉面。白白一大坨头大的面团，只见她又搓又揉，又撒粉又翻整，白净的额上满是晶莹汗珠。
瞧她辛苦，段柯古一时间竟忘了自己想说什么。
“公子唤我何事？”如意头未抬地问。
段柯古猛地回神。“在下是来为刚才的举动道歉，在下真不该怀疑姑娘的手艺。”
一连听他喊了两声在下，稍融了如意脸上寒冰。
第1章(2)
她将揉好面团往桌角一推，美眸一睨。“在下在下，你这会儿不就平贴躺在泥地上了？”
被取笑了。段柯古脸一热。
“这……”当朝文武百官谁人不知他段柯古博学强记、饱读诗书，还与他两位在家中同样排行十六的好友合称“文坛三十六”，可没想到了江南，竟被一个十七、八岁小姑娘，逗得回不出话来。
见他尴尬，如意好心造了个台阶让他下。“我们这儿不过是蓬户茅庐，公子不用那么客气。”
“是。”段柯古允，然后见她又混起了面粉跟水，他一数桌边十多个面团。“姑娘揉这么多面团，是打算？”
“馒头。”如意解释。本以为他听完该会自动找借口离开，可一连揉了两个面团，抬头，犹见他兴致勃勃，这会儿换她感到好奇了。
“公子打算一下午耗在这儿？您不是才刚到城里，不需要帮自己找间客栈歇息？”
“啊对。”她不提他还真忘了，段柯古挲著脸笑。“我是看姑娘动作俐落，一时著迷，竟然忘了来意。刚那盘鸡子炒饭，多少银两？”
“五文。”

他有没有听错？!正掏钱囊的段柯古猛地抬头。
“太贵？”她直视他的眼。
“是太便宜。”段柯古由衷地说：“刚才那盘炒饭香软松滑，到现在我还觉得余香犹存，说真话，姑娘要我付十贯钱我也无二话。”
在当时，十贯钱就足以让一家四口舒舒服服过上两、三个月了。
“好啊。”如意故意顺他话说。“那你就付十贯钱吧！”
见他真从钱囊里掏出一串钱锭，她叹一声，拿湿布抹净手后，又将钱锭塞回他手。
她纤白的手指擦过他掌腹瞬间，段柯古心窝突然多震了几下。
在长安，至交好友温庭筠常拖著他造访勾栏花院，见过的标致姑娘还会少了？可就没一个人，能像她这样一碰，就教他心湖泛起涟漪来。
如意笑著说：“跟你说笑你还当真了，五文就五文，多了我不收。”
“你手艺有那价值。”这是他肺腑之言。
如意出身富甲，近年虽因变故流落在外，可眼界底蕴仍旧是有的。可现在不知怎么回事，被他一双黑瞳一盯，她耳根竟热了起来。
她赶忙低头，假借搓揉面团掩掉心头的骚乱。“真这么看中我手艺，明天就早点来排队。再赶不及，我可不会再特意为你做什么了。”
她这话说得合情合理，可段柯古听了，却觉得哪边可惜。
“真不能两者兼具？”他意思是他会来排队，但也希望她能再额外做点什么。
她当然听出来了。“你当我什么？你顾请的厨娘？”
她那双水汪汪的大眼含嗔带恼，配上她秀雅的面容，瞧起来可爱极了。
真是一语惊醒梦中人！段柯古双眼一亮。他怎么没想到，他可以雇她做府里的厨娘！
“你愿意吗？”
这人在开什么玩笑？!如意一瞪，随手捻来一小撮粉，往他头脸一喷。
“早点回去歇息吧你！”她啊，压根儿没把他话惦心上。

被赶出小屋的段柯古连连叹气。
难怪如意姑娘不理他。瞧瞧他，一身全是尘土，要突然介绍自己是将上任的江州刺史，鬼才信他。
他背紧行囊大步前迈。
没关系，现最要紧是找个客栈落脚，好好梳洗一番，反正他会在扬州待上一阵，有的是时间跟她周旋。
当晚，段柯古换上一身洁净白衫与银灰色大袖，尾随在熙来攘往的食客后方，来到他向往已久的饭庄——“小莲庄”。
“小莲庄”门就开在大街上，一进大红门，可瞧见两列参天高耸的林木一路绵延。如鹤立鸡群的他很快引来跑堂注意，尤其近眼一瞧他温文儒雅宛如天神下凡的模样，更是教跑堂摆出恭敬脸色。
“爷里边请，敢问您是一人来，还是跟人有约？”
段柯古答：“一个人。”
跑堂恭敬脸色倏敛。现在“小莲庄”待客之道已不若从前，孤身客早已不受欢迎。“那请问您是想辟屋另坐，还是跟其他客倌一道坐厅上？”
段柯古环视左右。“我一个人要一间房太浪费，就坐厅上吧！”
听他一答，跑堂仅余的一点恭敬，瞬间都没了。
所谓辟屋另坐，就表示来客银囊饱满，身分不凡，跑堂当然好生伺候。换句话说坐厅上，就意谓来客不过是颗绣花枕头——试想，一般贵客哪愿意跟普通百姓平坐大厅？!
content_en:
This is the basic way to treat guests.
After a while, Qu's mother brought out a plate of side dishes from the kitchen.
"This is the pickled zucchini we pickled in Ruyi's hands. It's very crispy. You can try it for an appetizer."
As soon as Qu Mu was put down, a salty and fresh aroma rushed towards Duan Kegu. There was a surge of saliva in his mouth. He took a piece of it into his mouth and realized why Qu's mother dared to boast so much. This pickled melon is really crisp, salty and fragrant, and you can taste the sweetness as soon as you put it in your mouth. It makes people taste it again and again and can't bear to stop eating.
After hitting the bottom, Duan Kegu was finally willing to raise his head. He couldn't help but praise: "Miss Guanqu is still young, I didn't expect to have such skills!"
Just with this plate of pickled melons, Duan Kegu almost compared Qu Ruyi to the "one-stop" Zhang Laolong Yan!
In Chang'an, he once asked Long Yan for advice on cutting and cooking techniques, and knew that hard work and talent are absolutely necessary for exquisite craftsmanship. When Yi Longyan was in his twenties, he was already one of a hundred to be called "Yi Ya's Reincarnation", but now, there is actually a girl of seventeen or eighteen years old who can make such delicious pickles!
Qu's mother often heard her daughter being praised, and her expression was relaxed. "Despite our young age, Ruyi has been busy in the kitchen since she could speak. But the plate of pickles just now was so delicious, partly because of the help of her late husband. Her father left a recipe book. She wrote down what to add to the pickles and how long to marinate them..."
"Mother!" Ruyi suddenly jumped out and interrupted.
Duan Kegu was shocked, and so was Qu's mother. She got so excited about chatting that she suddenly forgot that they had a recipe, but it was a secret that couldn't be mentioned.
What's wrong? His face is so solemn?
Duan Kegu was about to ask clearly, but Qu's mother covered her mouth and kept silent, and kept retreating to the inner room.
"I'm tired, I'll go and rest first -"
"What's wrong, auntie?" Duan Kegu couldn't help but ask when he saw Ruyi approaching with fried rice.
Ruyi didn't answer, but quietly put down the pottery plate and put down the soup ladle and chopsticks with his other hand.
"Master, please use it slowly."
Duan Kegu suddenly forgot what he was saying until he saw the white and yellow chicken fried rice with distinct grains in front of him. Although the stir-fried ingredients are leftover meat patties, the salted fish and minced meat go well with chicken and white rice, and are even more lively and fragrant when sprinkled with finely chopped green onions.
Take a bite and put it into your mouth. The elasticity of the rice, the softness of the chicken and the aroma of the salted fish fill your heart and spleen. Only then did he realize how ridiculous his worries just now were.
Since he started eating, he never had time to raise his head to speak. He just took one mouthful after another, as if someone was trying to steal it from him.
After eating one plate, he took another sip of the still warm tea - he felt relieved. The feeling he felt at this moment could only be described by four words: feeling relaxed.
No wonder there are poems praising: "Between the Jianghuai River and the Huaihe River, the big town of Guangling is the richest in the world." Yangzhou is really an outstanding place, and even a small shop on the corner of the road can make such delicious food!
Thinking about it again, he looked forward to the skills of the chefs at "Xiaolianzhuang".
You have to praise her properly - what about just people? Duan Kegu was so focused on eating that he didn't even notice Ruyi leaving.
He turned around to look for the beautiful woman. "Girl Ruyi?"
"I'm in there."
Following the sound, I happened to see her kneading dough in the kitchen. There was a big lump of dough, which she kneaded and kneaded, sprinkled with flour and turned, and her fair forehead was covered with glistening beads of sweat.
Seeing her hard work, Duan Kegu forgot what he wanted to say for a while.
"Why did the young master call me?" Ruyi asked without raising her head.
Duan Kegu suddenly came back to his senses. "I'm here to apologize for my actions just now. I really shouldn't doubt the girl's skills."
Hearing him shout twice in a row slightly melted the ice on Ruyi's face.
Chapter 1(2)
She pushed the kneaded dough to the corner of the table and glanced at it. "My lord, aren't you lying flat on the dirt right now?"
Got teased. Duan Kegu's face heated up.
"This..." No one among the civil and military officials at that time knew that Duan Kegu was erudite and memorized, well-read poetry and books, and together with his two friends who were also ranked sixteenth in the family, they were collectively known as the "Thirty-Sixth in the Literary Circle", but they didn't expect that Jiangnan, was actually teased speechless by a seventeen- or eighteen-year-old girl.
Seeing his embarrassment, Ruyi kindly built a step for him to get down. "We are just a thatched cottage here, sir, you don't have to be so polite."
"Yes." Duan Keguyun saw her mixing flour and water again, and he counted more than ten dough balls at the table. "Girl, what's your plan for kneading so much dough?"
"Steamed buns." Ruyi explained. She thought he would automatically find an excuse to leave after hearing this, but after kneading two pieces of dough in a row, she looked up and saw that he was very interested. Now she was curious.
"Young Master, you plan to spend the whole afternoon here? Haven't you just arrived in the city and don't need to help yourself find an inn to rest?"
"Ah, right." She really forgot that he didn't mention it, Duan Kegu smiled with a smile on his face. "I was fascinated by the girl's neat movements, and I forgot why I came here. How much is that plate of chicken fried rice?"
"Five articles."
Did he hear correctly? !Duan Kegu, who was taking out his money bag, suddenly looked up.
"Too expensive?" She looked directly into his eyes.
"It's too cheap." Duan Kegu said sincerely: "The fried rice just now was soft and smooth, and I still feel that the fragrance is still there. To be honest, if the girl asked me to pay ten guan, I would not hesitate."
At that time, ten dollars was enough for a family of four to live comfortably for two or three months.
"Okay." Ruyi deliberately followed his words. "Then you pay ten dollars!"
Seeing that he actually took out a bunch of money ingots from his purse, she sighed, wiped her hands with a wet cloth, and then stuffed the money ingots back into his hand.
The moment her delicate white fingers brushed against his palm, Duan Kegu's heart suddenly trembled a few times.
In Chang'an, his close friend Wen Tingyun often dragged him to visit Goulan Garden. How many more beautiful girls could he meet? But there was no one who could make his heart ripple with just a touch like her.
Ruyi smiled and said: "I'm joking with you, but you take it seriously. Five cents is five cents. I won't accept more."
"Your skills are valuable." This was what he said from the bottom of his heart.
Ruyi was born into a wealthy family. Although he has been living abroad due to changes in recent years, he still has a good vision and background. But now, for some reason, her ears started to heat up when he stared at her with a pair of black eyes.
She quickly lowered her head, pretending to knead the dough to cover up the turmoil in her heart. "If you really like my craftsmanship, come early tomorrow to line up. If you can't make it in time, I won't do anything special for you anymore."
What she said was reasonable, but when Duan Kegu heard it, he felt it was a pity.
"Can't you really do both?" He meant that he would come to queue, but he also hoped that she could do something extra.
Of course she heard it. "What do you think I am? The cook you hired?"
Her big, watery eyes were full of anger and annoyance, and paired with her elegant face, she looked extremely cute.
What a word that awakens the dreamer! Duan Kegu's eyes lit up. Why didn't he think that he could hire her to be the cook in the house!
"Would you do that?"
What kind of joke is this guy kidding? Ruyi glared, picked up a handful of powder and sprayed it on his head and face.
"Go back and rest early!" She didn't pay attention to his words at all.
Duan Kegu sighed repeatedly after being kicked out of the hut.
No wonder Miss Ruyi ignored him. Look at him, his whole body is covered in dust. If he suddenly introduces himself as the governor of Jiangzhou who is about to take office, no one would believe him.
He packed his bag and strode forward.
It doesn't matter, the most important thing now is to find an inn to stay and freshen up. Anyway, he will stay in Yangzhou for a while and have plenty of time to deal with her.
That night, Duan Kegu put on a clean white shirt and silver-gray sleeves, and followed the bustling diners to the restaurant he had longed for - "Xiaolianzhuang".
The door of "Xiaolianzhuang" opens on the street. As soon as you enter the Dahongmen, you can see two rows of towering trees stretching all the way. Standing out from the crowd, he quickly attracted the attention of the waiter. Especially when he saw him up close, he looked as gentle and elegant as a god descending from the earth, which made the waiter put on a respectful expression.
"Please, please, I would like to ask if you are coming alone or have an appointment with someone? "
Duan Kegu replied: "A person. "
The waiter's respectful expression turned pale. Nowadays, the hospitality of "Xiaolianzhuang" is no longer what it used to be, and single guests are no longer welcome. "Then would you like to have a separate room to sit in, or would you like to sit in the living room with other guests? "
Duan Kegu looked around. “It’s too wasteful for me to have a room by myself, so I’ll just sit in the living room! "
After hearing his answer, the remaining respect from the waiter was gone in an instant.
The so-called sitting in a separate room means that the visitor has a full purse and a distinguished status, so the waiter will certainly be happy to serve him. In other words, sitting in the hall means that the visitor is just an embroidered pillow - just imagine, how can ordinary distinguished guests be willing to sit in the hall on the same level as ordinary people? !
